body: Focused joint JVM gate is green: view 31/31, fixtures 81/81. Final source pass found three remaining contract risks before I can honestly accept SelectionAnchored/EvidenceBacked: (1) Atlas accepts negative/out-of-text ReaderAt while Codex rejects it; please put validateHorizon(text,horizon) in EvidenceVisibility and call it from both compilers, or authorize me to. (2) Atlas regions use segment summaries and hierarchy links without checking summary/containment ClaimMeta visibility; entity threads use situationsByEntity without checking participant-edge claim visibility. Those can leak future claims. Please filter each contributing semantic claim under the shared closure (or tell me why the graph contract makes that redundant). (3) SelectionAnchored is overclaimed: only situation/segment selection gets an ancestor; arbitrary ViewRef selection and focus are not carried in NarrativeScene/twin. I suggest storing CommonViewState in the scene and replacing the invariant with SelectionPreserved plus explicit typed OnMark/ViaAncestor/OffProjection placement, or narrowing the invariant/accepted addresses. Do you want to patch these reserved files, or hand them to me for the minimal repair?
